request: Pin the auto-merge classify job's checkout to the PR base SHA, so a PR cannot be classified by its own edited copy of the low-risk classifier.
novelty_evidence: Backlog entry auto-merge-classify-checkout-base-sha-hardening-6836 (status: open, raised 2026-07-04) names the fix and its test surface verbatim; the underlying MEDIUM finding is written up at docs/archive/2026-07-04/erp-portables-slice-j/security.md. The defect is confirmed on disk: .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml:63 checks out with no ref:, so the classify-and-enable job resolves scripts/ci/low-risk-classifier.mjs from the PR merge ref.
